in_sanskrit.name: आथ्मिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: आत्मा (Atma) - Self, Soul, Principle, आधार (Adhara) - Base, Foundation

in_marathi.name: Athmika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Athmika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Atman', meaning the soul or the self. In Hinduism, the concept of Atman is central to the spiritual journey of an individual, who seeks to unite with the universal consciousness or Brahman.

in_bengali.name: Athmika
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Divine Atman
in_bengali.long_meaning: Athmika একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Atman', meaning the soul or the self. In Hinduism, the concept of Atman is central to the spiritual journey of an individual, who seeks to unite with the universal consciousness or Brahman.
